name: US Visual Novel
source:
Dive into five mysterious stories, each marked by a strange whisper from far, far away.

This faint sound crosses the boundaries of sky, time, and space. Barely audible, it seems to rise from a forgotten past, disturbing every being who hears it.

The characters in these five tales don’t know each other, yet there’s an elusive connection between them. Each one moves forward in their own way — hesitating, choosing. And still, an invisible force seems to guide them, to push them to act together, shaping the course of events.

Maybe what we’re living now is only the echo of something ancient… or perhaps, a warning of what’s to come?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851750/]Steam[/url]]
